title: We Built a $2M App: This is How We Grew It
description:
Charles and Kelvin built a $1M app called Gleam. They've tried every marketing strategy under the sun and in this episode, we dive into the growth tactics that helped them build a successful app. 

*Mobile App Growth Cheat Sheet:* https://clickhubspot.com/21ur

Say hi to Charles: https://www.instagram.com/charles.unemployed/ & https://twitter.com/CharlesLiu9
Say hi to Kelvin: https://www.instagram.com/kelvin.zhg/ & https://twitter.com/kelvinzhg
